news.headline: Crude oil +1.75% (WTI $103.8, Brent $112.7) - elevated energy prices persist
news.what_happened: WTI and Brent extended gains for the session; Brent is hovering near the $110-114 zone seen through late October.
news.why_it_matters: Higher crude lifts upstream realisations (ONGC, OIL) and weighs on airlines, paints, tyres and logistics input costs.

news.headline: Nasdaq -1.38%, S&P 500 -0.3% - tech-led risk-off in US
news.what_happened: US tech sold off while the 10Y yield eased about 1% to 4.99%. Nikkei fell 2.7%, Hang Seng rose 1.2%.
news.why_it_matters: Nasdaq weakness is a negative cue for Indian IT services; mixed Asia limits broad risk-on.

news.headline: Nifty closed 22,937 (+0.82%); rupee steady at 95.18
news.what_happened: Nifty rebounded in the prior session; USD/INR was flat and the dollar index eased 0.3%.
news.why_it_matters: Flat rupee gives no currency edge to exporters; domestic sentiment is fragile with FIIs net sellers through October (about Rs 51,466 Cr through Oct 23).

sector_outlook.reason: Hang Seng up, Nikkei down, mixed Asia
US yields easing but FII flows weak

picks.logic: Upstream realisation per barrel rises directly with crude; ONGC's earnings are highly sensitive to Brent at $110+. Modest target sized to a typical single-session macro move.
Oil India is a pure upstream producer with realisations tied to crude; higher Brent flows straight into revenue.
